summary: Created the appworker account on node1 (RHEL 7.9) and configured /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf to cap its login sessions at 8192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc), soft and hard. Confirmed pam_limits is wired into system-auth/password-auth so the limits apply to login sessions, and verified via `su - appworker` that ulimit -n returns 8192 and ulimit -u returns 256. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured a pre-restart boot_id/uptime/account baseline, triggered `shutdown -r now` (acknowledgement returned before disconnect), polled until node1 was reachable again, proved the boot_id changed (151c4aa9... -> d407be00...) and uptime reset to the reboot time, and re-verified the appworker account and its 8192/256 limits still hold post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS release and confirmed appworker did not yet exist
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256
Verified pam_limits.so is required in /etc/pam.d/system-auth and password-auth
Verified enforced limits via su - appworker -c 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, uptime -s, id/getent for appworker)
Triggered non-blocking 'shutdown -r now' on node1 so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until it became reachable again
Confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reset, proving an actual restart
Re-verified appworker account, limits.d config, and enforced ulimits post-restart

evidence.summary: Confirmed no pre-existing appworker user, then created it with useradd -m; id shows uid=1001(appworker).

evidence.requirement: Login session limits set to 8192 open files / 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d/appworker.conf with nofile/nproc 8192/256, confirmed pam_limits.so active in system-auth/password-auth, and verified via su - appworker that ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256.
Captured boot_id, uptime -s, and appworker account state before reboot.
Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' returned 'reboot_triggered' immediately, confirming ack before disconnect.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart disconnects and later becomes reachable again
evidence.summary: Probe failed with connection timeout during reboot, then succeeded on a later poll once node1 came back.

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a to d407be00-56c2-4393-9e87-933dbe6b0e09 and uptime -s reset to the reboot time, not just elapsed time.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of appworker account and its resource limits
evidence.summary: appworker account still present after reboot; limits.d/appworker.conf intact; su - appworker shows ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256 still enforced.
